title: Rift of Reason: Enforce two-copy limits and construction colour quotas
acceptance: Twenty-card personal decks, maximum two per creature species or named spell; ten contributed Axioms with maximum two per named rule.

Per colour, spell copies are at most creature copies of that colour in the submitted deck. Generic spells use no colour quota. Remove the live-board colour gate; a legal colour spell still casts with no matching creature in play.

Builder shows copy/quota counts and actionable rejection reasons; persisted/imported/team-code/AI decks use the same validation. Preserve legacy inventory and surface invalid custom decks for repair rather than silently replacing cards.

Cover 3 creatures/3 spells accepted, fourth rejected, third identical card rejected, generic freedom, duplicated Axioms across both contributions, casting without a matching board creature, and backup round trips.
label: rift: engine

title: Rift of Reason: Add the simple common starter creature and spell pack
acceptance: Implement the seven creature and five spell drafts linked below, with no legendary/uncommon dependencies or scheduled Fate requirement.

Cards have readable text, working authoritative effects, legal targets, AI support and usable placeholder artwork; add new art to the existing request list. Do not generate voice/art until wording is settled.

Exercise every new effect in a real battle and with the engine; temporary attack expires, health/healing are coherent, Guard is visible. Compare against current commons and adjust draft costs if evidence requires it.
label: rift: content

title: Rift of Reason: Grant five persistent avatar-type starter decks
acceptance: Grant the five exact proposed 12-creature/8-spell starters and default ten Axioms as real owned cards/loadouts once per adventure. Each avatar type uses the same list for both variants.
Grant/unlock pools and a versioned receipt live in the existing save object and survive backup/import. Reloads, avatar appearance changes and chapter jumps cannot repeat the grant.

Existing players receive a safe idempotent catch-up path preserving catches, earned unlocks and custom loadouts. Tutorial loaners remain separate; ordinary starting battles do not silently pad illegal decks with loans.
Validate every list with the shared rules and both actual avatar powers; make first owned-deck battle playable before catching more creatures.
label: rift: battle

title: Rift of Reason: Teach deck construction in a replayable starter workshop
acceptance: Offer an optional deck-building tutorial before first owned-deck play and replay from Collection. Use the selected starter and show its strategy and both variant powers.
Teach 20/20 personal, 10/10 Axioms, two copies per named card and colour quotas. Learner repairs a third copy and an over-quota colour spell; generic spells remain available.

Demonstrate a colour spell casting without a matching creature on the battlefield. Remove obsolete live-colour instructions/tooltips from existing lessons without expanding the short battle lesson into a workshop.
Support keyboard/click/touch, clear mistakes/retry, short plain English and no progress loss. Record settled voices later through #43.
label: rift: content

title: Rift of Reason: Make Fate advance per full round with locked public forecasts
acceptance: First player turn, second player turn, then exactly one ordinary Fate advance. Countdown labels use full rounds and agree with actual resolution for either starting player.
Lock and display the exact next announced axiom/reset effect; later shared draws cannot silently replace it. Represent a reserved rule consistently so it is neither duplicated nor drawn twice.

Preview source/effect/rounds, synchronize notes/audio/Calm movement and preserve deterministic replay/save data. Existing explicit time abilities remain understandable; do not introduce replayable-event semantics here.
Test odd/even turn boundaries, first-player variants, announced rule identity, reset, empty rule sources and interrupted visuals. Related #66/#109; do not create a second animation owner.
label: rift: engine

title: Rift of Reason: End stalled battles with exhaustion obeying the Win axiom
acceptance: At a normal draw step, when that player personal deck and shared Axiom source are empty, apply proposed escalating exhaustion 1,2,3 damage, once per own turn. Opponent personal deck is irrelevant.
Empty shared deck alone is harmless; personal-empty/shared-available can still draw Axioms. Full hand is not exhaustion. Extra draws/time choices do not multiply or evade normal exhaustion.
Exhaustion uses the current victory rule, including own-zero-hearts winning, with clear impending damage and cause. Counter persists through deterministic battle restore; AI can finish stalled games.

Before implementation settle shared-discard recycling and numeric tuning with teacher (recommended finite shared deck). Test each emptiness combination, recycling decision, normal/reversed Win, both heroes defeated, and special draw rules.
label: teacher in the loop

title: Rift of Reason: Settle Fate landing, skipping, replay and expiry rules
acceptance: Present a small deterministic worked example covering ordinary entry, a two-space leap bypassing a node, rewind onto a fired node, one-shot summon, marked repeatable buff and expiry.

Proposed default: scheduled spells are one-shot; only marked repeatable spaces replay; lifetime counts elapsed full rounds independent of cursor rewind. Confirm or revise with teacher before changing these semantics.
Specify pending-event capacity, source death, full board/hand, simultaneous event order, invalid targets, cancellation, reset versus queued events and lossless battle saves.
Publish the agreed finite state model and deterministic acceptance examples. This is a design gate, not a ticket to silently invent rules.
label: teacher in the loop

title: Rift of Reason: Ship the first public scheduled Fate spell: Clean Slate
acceptance: Implement Clean Slate as the draft generic spell: schedule a public all-creature wipe two full rounds ahead. Card play, event node, inspectable countdown, actual engine resolution and spent status form one complete playable slice.
Resolve affected creatures at firing time, with normal Last Words and winner checks; source/controller/targets are explicit. AI sees only public schedule and can react.
Queued state saves/restores and is resolved once despite repeated clicks/navigation/visual cancellation. Owner/source removal and reset follow the agreed policy.
Provide a real playable bench/tutorial demonstration and tests proving preview matches resolution under normal/changed Axioms. Preserve #66 pacing and Calm motion.
label: rift: engine

title: Rift of Reason: Make Fate leaps and rewind interact with marked repeatable spaces
acceptance: Implement draft Leap Ahead, Revisit and Echoing Encouragement using the agreed policy. Show intermediate skipped nodes, landed node, consumed one-shot history and expiry clearly.
Demonstrate bypassing an enemy plan, re-entering the +1/+1 space, no duplicate one-shot summons, and elapsed-round expiry that rewind cannot extend.
Use finite deterministic transitions and existing action/activation budgets; cap/cancel presentation work, preserve focus and expose exact effects in inspection.
Tests cover both directions, consecutive abilities, expired/skipped events, changing controller/rules, saved replay and duplicate-submit resistance.
label: rift: engine

title: Rift of Reason: Add the first colour-scheduled spells and temporal Axiom pack
acceptance: Implement five colour-scheduled spell drafts and the four temporal Axiom families from the linked draft, with earnable progression rather than replacing default starters.

Construction quotas apply even though no live matching creature is required; previews expose only public information. Both players share Axiom effects and replacement categories. Existing announced events stay fixed when delay Axioms change.
Handle invalidated targets/full board/hand/source loss according to agreed policy, keep current values/explanations synchronized and test rule replacement/reset.
Coordinate general +/-1/+/-2 and Unlimited content with existing #101 rather than duplicate it. Simulate/tune costs and unlock pacing before exposing the pack to students.
label: rift: content

title: Rift of Reason: Refine approved layout A with owner decks, Axiom panel and contextual inspection
acceptance: Mirror chosen owner card-back decks beside energy (own above, opponent below); put shared Axiom deck centre-left. Keep the symmetric battlefield.

Permanent right column shows active Axioms; restore contextual full-text/Active-effects inspection without obscuring targets/actions. Reduce competing modifier labels and show target-dependent bonuses when relevant.
Guard has a clear large backplate, distinct from Shield bubble and both simultaneously legible. Upcoming Fate nodes show inspectable effects and full-round timing when available.

Verify crowded/narrow/zoom, keyboard/click/drag/touch and Calm motion with actual engine states. Coordinate production renderer continuity with #109 and motion with #66; do not close parents or bypass required Granny questions.
label: rift: battle

title: Rift of Reason: Draft and review 210 new cards before staged content release
acceptance: Create 210 distinct design concepts: 28 for each of six colours plus 42 generic (20%). Cover creature, spell, Axiom, Fate and alternative-victory strategies. Avoid recoloured duplicates.
Use common/uncommon/rare/mythic/legendary tiers with readable consistent frames. Make a creative strategy/interaction matrix, costs and counterplay explicit; draft numbers are not balance results.

Stage implementation after approved board refinement and production integration #109; scheduled cards also wait for #118/#119/#120 as applicable. Coordinate Axioms with #101. Document artwork needs, reuse shared effect sounds, and test/tune small packs before the next.
label: rift: content

title: Rift of Reason: Audit story card rewards and collection progression
acceptance: Inventory card/catch/item/currency rewards across all four chapters and repeat visits, including non-ideal puzzle results. Measure time to first meaningful deck swap and colour strategy.
Propose and implement a staged reward cadence feeding common starters into optional spell/Axiom/Fate strategies without requiring grinding. Preserve catch rewards and legacy progress.
Report simulated and observed acquisition rates, chapter gaps, rarity mix, unlock bottlenecks and avoid paying all rewards only at bosses. Coordinate with the expansion/economy plans.
label: rift: content

title: Rift of Reason: Playtest catching and lure supply as a separate gameplay loop
acceptance: Perform real click playtests plus repeatable simulations of catching, lure activation/duration, item use and failed catches across chapters.

Measure engagement, meaningful choice, odds communication, items spent per catch, consecutive-failure runs and whether ordinary play replenishes supplies. Account for optional catches, low puzzle scores, avatar perks and rarity.

Tune only evidence-backed problems; player can recover from depleted inventory without a dead end. Preserve save/backups and add meaningful regression coverage for any actual changes. Publish a short evidence report.
label: rift: battle

title: Rift of Reason: Design earned-currency packs and duplicate-to-foil protection
acceptance: Audit existing currency/shop/sell systems first; reuse earned in-game currency. Draft prices, income, sell exclusions and reward cadence; do not add real-money purchasing.

Collection progression per card: first two draws give normal copies, third/fourth upgrade those copies to foil cosmetics, then exclude that card from eligible packs. Preserve unique caught instances and existing usable unlocks during migration.

Renormalize rarity weights over eligible cards, disclose odds/progress, handle empty tiers and fully completed collection without charging for an unusable pack. Do not claim unapproved guarantee/pity rules.

Purchase and rewards commit once in the canonical save before presentation; reload/cancel cannot double-charge or reroll committed rewards. Build accessible reveal with shared sounds, short rarity accents, Calm/skip and restrained foil sheen.

Decide pack size/weights/prices and starter/earned/legacy ownership interactions with teacher, then implement in narrow demoable slices after #109. Test conservation of currency, copies and cosmetics plus backups.
label: teacher in the loop
